crumble.target: Visible eligible solid ruin or magical wall
crumble.effect: Open a 1.5″ passage through the ruin, or remove a conjured wall. Figures above the removed section may fall; a Move test against 22 can let them escape.

decay.effect: Destroy the chosen eligible weapon, not the entire figure. Magical or otherwise protected weapons may be excluded by the target list.

fast_act.target: Unactivated ally or neutral creature in sight, up to 24″
fast_act.effect: Queue that figure for an early activation. Cannot target yourself, a figure already queued, or a group member.

fleet_feet.effect: Move +2″. Useful for treasure recovery and reaching combat.
fleet_feet.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

petrify.target: Visible figure, up to 24″; Will resistance
petrify.effect: On failed resistance, Fight −3 (minimum 0) and skip the next activation. Large targets gain +8 on resistance.
petrify.duration: The activation skip clears after activation; Fight penalty remains until removed.

slow.effect: Limit the target to one action per activation. If cast on the active figure, its remaining actions become zero.
slow.duration: Will test at end of each affected activation may remove it.

time_store.target: Self, at start of a normal two-action activation
time_store.effect: End this activation and store an action for later use. Use the stored-action command when eligible.
time_store.duration: Until the stored action is used; see contextual command.

time_walk.target: Wizard only, during wizard phase; self
time_walk.effect: Gain further activations in the apprentice and soldier phases. Casting successfully in consecutive turns costs 8 Health.

call_storm.effect: Increase the global shooting penalty by 1, to a maximum of −5. Also affects your own shooters.
call_storm.duration: Ongoing; counter magic removes one casting.

destructive_sphere.effect: Each nearby figure faces a +5 direct attack against its Fight. Includes allies; no ordinary shooting cover calculation.

elemental_ball.effect: Resolve +5 magical shots against the target and visible figures within 1″ of it, including combat participants and friendly figures in the area.

elemental_bolt.effect: Resolve a +7 magical shooting attack against the target's defence. Cover and other shot modifiers apply; casting success alone does not guarantee damage.

elemental_hammer.effect: Increase damage from a damaging weapon attack. Applies to the target's relevant melee or ranged weapon; it does not guarantee a hit.
elemental_hammer.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

elemental_shield.effect: Absorb the next 3 points of incoming damage using a separate shield pool.
elemental_shield.duration: Until the pool is spent or dispelled.

scatter_shot.effect: Make a separate +0 magical shooting attack against each eligible enemy in the area. Shots into combat may redirect to combatants.

wall.target: Place a visible 6″ × 1″ strip, with a visible point within 10″
wall.effect: Create a 3″ high solid wall blocking movement and sight. Rotate the placement to make cover or close a route; cannot overlap figures or blocking terrain.
wall.duration: From subsequent turns, removed on an end-turn d20 roll of 1–4.

animate_construct.target: Campaign preparation; available construct and roster space
animate_construct.effect: Add a permanent small, medium or large construct. Medium has −3 to cast; large −6. No Health empowerment outside battle.

control_construct.target: Eligible visible construct within 24″; Will resistance
control_construct.effect: If resistance fails, take control of the construct. One controlled creature per caster for this spell; can release it using the contextual command.
control_construct.duration: Until released, removed or battle ends.

embed_enchantment.target: After a battle; eligible recovered enchantment
embed_enchantment.effect: Convert a qualifying enchantment reward into a permanent item. Select the eligible reward from the campaign list.

enchant_armour.target: Visible soldier with base Armour 11+, within 24″
enchant_armour.effect: Armour +1, subject to the normal Armour cap of 15 for non-creatures.
enchant_armour.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

enchant_weapon.target: Visible figure within 24″; ammunition option requires allied bow/crossbow user
enchant_weapon.effect: Give +1 Fight with a melee weapon or +1 Shoot with a ranged weapon. The separate ammunition option enchants ammunition instead.
enchant_weapon.duration: Weapon effect ongoing; ammunition option is consumed through its own attack command.

grenade.effect: Make +3 shooting attacks against figures whose bases touch the 1.5″ radius blast (including nearby combat participants). Allies can be hit.

strength.effect: Fight +2 before normal combat caps and modifiers.
strength.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

telekinesis.effect: Move it up to 6″ along a visible legal route (3″ in the Sinkhole). Frozen, guarded, protected, museum and uncollected central treasure are excluded.

beauty.effect: Eligible enemy figures must pass a Will test before targeting the caster. Creatures, animals and True Sight can bypass the protection.
beauty.duration: Ongoing; the test result is remembered per opponent per turn.

blink.target: Visible figure within 12″; unwilling target may resist
blink.effect: Move the target 4″ in a random direction, stopping at obstacles. Pulsing Gem options can extend to 6″ or reroll direction when available.

fools_gold.effect: Choose a legal drop location within 4″ of the carrier (6″ with Illusionist Staff). On failed resistance the carrier drops the selected treasure.

glow.effect: Attacks shooting at the glowing figure gain +3. Useful before focused ranged attacks.
glow.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

illusionary_soldier.target: Visible legal ground within 2″; also a campaign preparation ritual
illusionary_soldier.effect: Create an illusory thug in battle, or prepare a chosen soldier illusion before battle. Normally one illusion per warband; True Sight can dispel it.
illusionary_soldier.duration: Until revealed, removed or battle ends.

invisibility.effect: Hide the target from ordinary targeting. True Sight and clear-sight effects bypass it; combat and revealing actions can break it.
invisibility.duration: Until revealed, dispelled or battle ends.

teleport.effect: Instantly relocate to a valid landing point and exhaust the activation. No ordinary move path is needed.

transpose.target: Two visible figures within 12″ of each other and within 24″ of caster
transpose.effect: Swap their positions if the swap is legal and required resistance tests fail. Requires two target selections.

animate_skull.effect: Create a neutral animated skull. Usually one per caster; Skull Staff can allow two. Golden Fang can strengthen it.
animate_skull.duration: Until removed, cancelled or battle ends.

bone_dart.effect: Resolve a +5 shooting attack. The digital damage pipeline treats this as a physical projectile, rather than Elemental Bolt's magical attack.

bones_of_the_earth.effect: Pin the target in place, preventing normal movement and Leap. Plane Walk can free the caster.
bones_of_the_earth.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

control_undead.target: Eligible visible undead within 24″; Will resistance
control_undead.effect: Take control if resistance fails. Only one controlled creature for this spell per caster; release using contextual command.
control_undead.duration: Until released, removed or battle ends.

raise_zombie.target: Visible legal ground within 1.25″ on same level; or before battle ritual
raise_zombie.effect: Add an allied zombie. Normally one per warband; Skull Staff can raise the limit. Preparation deploys the zombie in the next battle.

spell_eater.target: Choose an ongoing effect, ward, terrain spell or control effect
spell_eater.effect: Cancel the selected ongoing magic, like Dispel. Casting attempt also costs 1 Health, even on failure.

steal_health.target: Visible opposing living non-construct figure within 24″; Will resistance
steal_health.effect: On failed resistance, inflict 3 Health loss and restore up to 3 Health to the caster.

strike_dead.target: Visible living non-construct figure within 8″, not self; Will resistance
strike_dead.effect: Failed resistance removes all remaining Health. Every target may empower its resistance; the cast attempt costs the caster 1 Health.

absorb_knowledge.target: After battle; wizard only, not knocked out last battle
absorb_knowledge.effect: Gain 40 campaign XP on success. Cannot be attempted once preparation for the next battle has started.

bridge.target: Choose a legal crossing; normal footprint 6″ × 2″
bridge.effect: Create a walkable magical ramp/bridge between legal endpoints. Extended Scroll can make it 9″ long. May be cancelled by its caster.
bridge.duration: At end of each turn, disappears on 1–2 (1 with extended bridge).

draining_word.target: Select a combat spell by name
draining_word.effect: Apply −3 to casting rolls for the named spell, including your own attempts. Cannot duplicate the same word effect.
draining_word.duration: Ongoing until countered or battle ends.

explosive_rune.target: Visible point within 4″; up to three per caster
explosive_rune.effect: Create a trap triggered by movement within 1″ of the rune's centre plus base radius. Explodes with +5 direct attacks within 2″ plus base radius, including allies.
explosive_rune.duration: Until triggered, removed, or it expires after the caster leaves play.

furious_quill.effect: Fight −2, Shoot −4, Move −1″ and casting −2. Useful against enemy casters or shooters.
furious_quill.duration: Will test at start of affected activation may remove it.

power_word.target: Select a combat spell by name
power_word.effect: Apply +3 to all casting rolls for the named spell, including enemy attempts. Cannot duplicate the same word effect.
power_word.duration: Ongoing until countered or battle ends.

push.effect: Roll d20+10 versus target's d20+Fight. If the push wins, move the target away by the positive difference between attack total and Armour, in inches; no direct damage, but falls may hurt.

write_scroll.target: After battle; chosen known spell or grimoire spell
write_scroll.effect: Create a scroll in the campaign vault. Scrolls allow their stored spell to be resolved without a normal casting roll.

awareness.effect: Prepare Awareness for the next battle, affecting the caster's activation priority.

combat_awareness.effect: Fight +1 and Armour +1, subject to normal caps.
combat_awareness.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

mind_control.target: Visible eligible non-caster within 24″; Will resistance
mind_control.effect: Take control of the figure on failed resistance. Cannot control mindless or Mind Locked targets. Only one target per caster.
mind_control.duration: Target tests Will at end of each activation to break control.

mind_lock.effect: Will +2, protection against Mind Control and Suggestion; releases current Mind Control.
mind_lock.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

reveal_secret.effect: Add one revealed-secret preparation token for the upcoming battle, which is used by scenario setup for extra treasure.

suggestion.target: Visible non-mind-locked figure within 24″, not self; Will resistance
suggestion.effect: Choose a legal destination within 3″ of target. Failed resistance makes it drop carried treasure and move there; may choose its current position.

true_sight.effect: Reveal invisible figures and remove illusions within 6″. Nearby allies can also see through illusion targeting restrictions.
true_sight.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

wizard_eye.effect: Place a remote viewpoint. Eligible spells may measure sight and range from its outward-facing side. Replaces your existing eye.
wizard_eye.duration: Until removed, replaced or its supporting terrain is destroyed.

control_demon.target: Eligible visible demon within 24″; Will resistance
control_demon.effect: Take control on failed resistance; cannot coexist with a prepared demon belonging to the caster. One controlled demon per caster.
control_demon.duration: Until released, removed or battle ends.

imp.target: Visible legal ground at least 4″ from every figure
imp.effect: Summon a neutral imp, not a controllable ally. Replaces your previous imp.

leap.target: Visible ally within 24″; choose legal landing
leap.effect: Move ally up to 10″, or 5″ if carrying treasure. May cross intervening terrain if the arc is clear; ends that figure's activation.

plague_of_insects.effect: Target and nearby susceptible figures suffer −4 Fight/Shoot (minimum 0) and −2 casting. Large, undead and construct figures are immune.
plague_of_insects.duration: Will test at end of affected target's activation may remove it.

planar_tear.effect: All figures whose bases touch a 2″ radius test Will against the casting result. Failure causes 2 Health loss, or Health loss equal to casting result for demons.

plane_walk.effect: Drop carried treasure, break Bones of the Earth and become phased: movement through ordinary obstacles and protection from targeting. Repeated consecutive attempts incur cumulative −5 casting (maximum −15).

possess.effect: Fight +2, Armour +1, Will −2; target counts as a demon. One possessed ally per caster.
possess.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

summon_demon.target: Visible legal ground within 2″; also special base preparation
summon_demon.effect: Summon a controlled imp, minor demon (margin 6+) or major demon (margin 13+), based on resolved casting result minus TN. Natural 1 instead summons a hostile demon. A Summoning Circle enables a two-roll preparation ritual.
summon_demon.duration: Until released, removed or battle ends.

banish.effect: Each demon tests Will against casting result. Failure destroys a demon with Will 4 or less; otherwise damage is three times the failed margin.

blinding_light.effect: Fight becomes 0, Move becomes 1″ and non-touch spell targeting is restricted.
blinding_light.duration: Will test at end of each turn may remove it.

circle_of_protection.target: Legal point within 2″ on same level; one per caster
circle_of_protection.effect: Create a ward with a 1.5″ radius that prevents undead and demons entering (includes base radius). Cannot place near existing such creatures.

destroy_undead.effect: Failure destroys a target with Will 2 or less; otherwise damage equals three times the failed margin.

dispel.target: Select ongoing spell effect, shield, control, terrain or word
dispel.effect: Remove the selected eligible ongoing magic, not all magic on the figure. Most figure and terrain targets must be visible within 24″.

heal.target: Visible wounded living non-construct figure within 6″
heal.effect: Restore up to 5 Health, not above maximum. If Health is restored, clear poison.

miraculous_cure.target: After battle; wizard only; eligible injured or revivable member
miraculous_cure.effect: Remove injuries and restore the chosen member where eligible. Reviving a dead member adds −4 to the cast.

shield.effect: Armour +2 (non-creatures capped at 15). Unlike Elemental Shield, this is an Armour bonus, not a damage pool.
shield.duration: Ongoing until removed or battle ends.

animal_companion.target: Before battle; eligible animal and available roster space
animal_companion.effect: Recruit a permanent animal companion (bear, ice toad, snow leopard or wolf). One companion per caster.

brew_potion.effect: Create the selected potion in the vault. Greater recipes are wizard-only, cost ingredients even on failure and have −4 casting.

control_animal.target: Eligible visible animal within 24″; Will resistance
control_animal.effect: Take control on failed resistance. One controlled animal per caster; release using contextual command.
control_animal.duration: Until released, removed or battle ends.

curse.effect: Apply −2 to rolls through the target's roll penalty, including combat and casting.
curse.duration: Will test at end of each turn may remove it.

familiar.effect: Prepare a familiar for the caster's next deployment, providing its campaign familiar benefit.

fog.target: Place a 6″ × 1″ strip fully within 24″, with at least one visible point
fog.effect: Create a 3″ high sight-blocking fog bank. Figures can move through it; rotate placement to block enemy sight.

mud.effect: Create a circular 6″ diameter patch of rough ground. Moving through it costs double movement.

poison_dart.effect: Resolve a +3 shooting attack. If it causes Health loss, inflict poison on susceptible targets, limiting their actions.
poison_dart.duration: Immediate attack; poison persists until cured.
